abstract: Maintains environmental mitigation approvals, permafrost disturbance permits, and flora protection filings
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance lead (ENV), responsible for maintaining environmental mitigation approvals, permafrost disturbance permits, and flora protection filings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental mitigation approvals, permafrost disturbance permits, and flora protection filings（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
ENV-PERMIT-O8P：For the Alto del Carmen Saddle, environmental impact mitigation clearance granted is false, as executive sign-off covering the proposed station footprint and civil works area has not been granted.
ENV-PERMIT-IPT：For the Cerro Las Tórtolas Plateau, environmental impact mitigation clearance granted has been confirmed based on executive sign-off covering the proposed station footprint and civil works area.
ENV-PERMIT-7HV：For the Paso San Francisco Ridge, environmental impact mitigation clearance granted has been confirmed based on executive sign-off covering the proposed station footprint and civil works area.

information_points.title: Alpine wildlife monitoring（WILD）
information_points.content:
ENV-WILD-5AX：According to the fauna protection perimeter survey for the Alto del Carmen Saddle, the vicuña migration buffer distance is 500 m from the station perimeter fence to the identified wildlife corridor.
ENV-WILD-Z8D：According to the fauna protection perimeter survey for the Paso San Francisco Ridge, the vicuña migration buffer distance is 800 m from the station perimeter fence to the identified wildlife corridor.
ENV-WILD-F9U：According to the fauna protection perimeter survey for the Cerro Las Tórtolas Plateau, the vicuña migration buffer distance is 300 m from the station perimeter fence to the identified wildlife corridor.
